fields.title: 📖 That by which the Ummah is set right again
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām Mālik ibn Anas (رحمه الله) said:**

***“The latter part of this Ummah will not be set right except by that by which its first part was set right.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**
**The Ummah is not renewed through new paths, modern inventions or distant standards**, but through the same light that raised its beginning: **the Qurʾān, the Sunnah and holding fast to the way of the Salaf.**

immutable.source: 📝 al-Qāḍī ʿIyāḍ, ash-Shifāʾ bi-taʿrīf ḥuqūq al-Muṣṭafā, Bd. 2, S. 448. Dort aus al-Mabsūṭ von Mālik angeführt.
